verdicts.reason: A is broken. The logo was pulled off its white band and now sits dark-on-navy, almost invisible. A stray white panel fragment in the top-right corner collides with the 'Reserve a Case' CTA. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, which ruins the reading order, and the orange divider is gone. B keeps the original structure and brand, but it is just a shrunken copy. The white logo band floats as a narrow box instead of running full width. The body copy, CTA label and 'Ships late June' are tiny at this size, there are wide empty navy margins on both sides and a dead area at the bottom, and the divider is barely visible.
